data.description:
Context: Dogfood capture by Brandon 2026-08-02, right after the focus ring (tuh-01KYXT2KAG7QXZGF1W47E6S8VT, PR #15) landed: the focused description's highlight "is broken between paragraphs instead of continuous". Diagnosis (confirmed by repro): detailLines indents the description (and renders the title) BEFORE wrapping to the terminal width, so wrapped continuation lines start at column 0 — off the two-cell mark column — and selectedText cannot place the ▌ gutter there (they also render flush-left, misaligned with the body indent; that raggedness predates the ring). Paragraph-break blank lines keep their prefix; continuations are the break. Decision (Brandon, 2026-08-02): keep the gutter + tint treatment, fix the wrap order — not tint-only, which would be invisible under NO_COLOR (selection.go: glyph survives, color does not).

The ask: In detailLines, wrap the title line and the description body to the mark column's inner width (width-2, same clamp discipline as escalationRow's wrapIndent) FIRST, then indent every resulting screen line onto the two-cell mark column — so a focused block's gutter and tint are continuous across wrapped continuations and blank paragraph separators, and unfocused continuations align with the body indent.

Acceptance: A focused multi-paragraph wrapping description renders the ▌ gutter on every line of the block — continuations and blank separators included; a focused wrapping title likewise; no rendered line exceeds the terminal width; existing golden/interaction tests updated where the new indent shows; make test lint green.

Pointers: cmd/tuhdoo/top.go detailLines (the add/addRaw helpers; escalationRow's wrapIndent is the precedent), selection.go selectedText.

Constraints: rendering only — no daemon/API changes; scope is the title and description blocks (field grid and history lines are not stops; their col-0 continuations are out of scope); boring Go.
data.title: Task view: wrap-then-indent the title and description blocks so the focus gutter is continuous
